meta.name: QuartzOS Reference Data
meta.description: Production-grade reference data for cannabis concentrate dabbing — banger form factors, concentrates, sensors, and temperature calibrations. Sourced from manufacturer documentation (Dab Rite, Highly Educated, Quave, Honeybee Herb), brand guidance (710 Labs, Mood, Press Club), and 2025-2026 community consensus.
meta.license: Open data for non-commercial integration. Verify temperature recommendations against current community testing before production deployment.
meta.temperature_convention: All concentrate.surface_temp_f values are INTERIOR SURFACE temperatures (probe-truth, Terpometer V1 contact). Sensor readings on instruments differ — use the sensor + banger.ir_offset_f + banger.ir_offset_sign math to convert.
data_sources: Dab Rite official documentation and 2025 placement guide (dabrite.com)
420 VapeZone empirical Dab Rite + slurper testing
Press Club temple ball / hash temp guidance

bangers.description: Quartz banger form factors in active 2025-2026 production. Each entry contains geometry, temperature ranges, IR calibration data, torch technique, and procedure metadata.

fields.name: Display name
fields.category: One of: classic | slurper | specialty | premium
fields.geometry: Thermal class for IR offset math: bucket | slurper | insert | enail. Drives ir_offset_sign.
fields.surface_temp_range_f: [low, high] interior surface temp where this banger is operable
fields.ir_offset_sign: Direction of offset: -1 = display reads LOWER than interior (bucket-class, IR sees cooler exterior wall); +1 = display reads HIGHER than interior (slurper-class, side-of-column wall is thinner and hotter); 0 = no offset (e-nail PID is its own system)
fields.ir_aim_location: Where to aim the IR thermometer (the most-disputed UX spec — verified against Dab Rite 2025 placement guide)
fields.heat_time_seconds: Total torch time as a string range (some bangers have multi-stage breakdowns)
fields.cooldown_seconds: Wait time after torch-off before dabbing
fields.torch_pattern: circular_sweep | circular_sweep_outer_only | circular_sweep_floor | sequenced | simultaneous_sweep | none
fields.torch_zones: Array of {anatomy, time_pct} describing where to focus the flame
fields.torch_distance_inches: Distance from inner-cone tip of Blazer Big Shot to quartz
fields.notable_manufacturers: Array of brands producing this form factor in 2026

concentrates.description: Cannabis concentrates in active 2025-2026 rotation. surface_temp_f values are INTERIOR SURFACE temps (Terpometer-equivalent, not Dab Rite IR readings).

fields.name: Display name
fields.surface_temp_optimal_f: Single optimal interior surface temp (midpoint of range or community consensus)
fields.good_for_cold_start: Boolean — concentrate benefits from cold-start workflow
fields.blocked: If present, this concentrate should NOT be dabbed. Value is the user-facing explanation.
fields.warning: If present, soft warning to display alongside dab recommendation
fields.notes: Array of contextual notes / why-this-temp explanations

sensors.description: Temperature measurement instruments. Method drives the calibration formula branch.

fields.name: Display name
fields.calibration_note: How this instrument relates to interior surface temp

wall_thicknesses.description: Banger wall thickness modifier. Thinner walls heat and cool faster.

fields.name: Display name
fields.modifier_f: °F to add to surface temp target (thicker = positive, thinner = negative)

explanation: 1. Start with concentrate.surface_temp_optimal_f (interior surface — what the dab actually contacts)
2. Apply wall.modifier_f (thicker walls hold more heat, target slightly higher)
3. Multiply banger.ir_offset_f by banger.ir_offset_sign (-1 for bucket-class, +1 for slurper-class, 0 for e-nail)
4. Add result to surface temp to get the displayed temp on the user's instrument

examples.scenario: Live Resin + Flat Top + IR + Standard wall
examples.math: 510 (interior) + 0 (wall) + (-1 * 35) (bucket-class IR offset) = 475°F displayed on Dab Rite

examples.scenario: Live Resin + Blender + IR + Standard wall
examples.math: 510 (interior) + 0 (wall) + (+1 * 20) (slurper-class IR offset) = 530°F displayed on Dab Rite

examples.scenario: Cold Cure Rosin + Terp Slurper + IR + Standard wall
examples.math: 460 (interior) + 0 (wall) + (+1 * 20) (slurper-class IR offset) = 480°F displayed on Dab Rite

examples.scenario: Live Resin + Flat Top + Probe + Standard wall
examples.math: 510 (interior) + 0 (wall) + 0 (probe is contact, no offset) = 510°F displayed on Terpometer

examples.scenario: Live Resin + E-Banger + PID + Standard wall

calibration.workflow_note: For IR-mode users: the Dab Rite alarms when temp DESCENDS through the set point. Torch past the displayed target, pull the flame, then dab when the alarm fires on the way down. Don't dab AT peak torch.

flame_anatomy.hottest_point: tip of inner blue cone where it meets outer envelope
flame_anatomy.common_misconception: Cone interior looks brightest but is NOT hottest — heat peaks at the cone tip where combustion completes

universal_rules: Use the TIP of the bright blue inner cone — not the cone interior
Keep flame moving — no stationary points (creates hot spots, devitrification)
Never torch a wet banger (thermal shock cracks quartz)
Never torch the joint connection (stress fractures)
Never torch with carb cap on during hot-start (uneven heat trapping)
Never torch to clean residue between dabs (carbonizes residue into surface)
common_mistakes: Chasing the orange glow every dab (devitrifies quartz, burns terps)
Stationary point heating (hot spots → chazzing → microfractures)
Torching with cap on during hot-start
Holding flame too close (buries quartz in cooler reducing zone)
Skipping cooldown after glow (concentrate combusts instead of vaporizes)
Using inner cone interior instead of cone tip
Torching to burn off residue between dabs

banger_geometries.label: Bucket-class
banger_geometries.description: IR display reads LOWER than interior surface

banger_geometries.label: Slurper-class
banger_geometries.description: IR display reads HIGHER than interior surface (thin column wall, direct flame)

banger_geometries.label: Insert workflow
banger_geometries.description: Read host banger temp, not insert directly

banger_geometries.label: E-nail (electric)
banger_geometries.description: PID setpoint, no torch, no IR needed

torch_patterns.label: Circular sweep — focus floor, not pillar

wall_thicknesses.name: Thin (2 mm)
wall_thicknesses.description: Light flat tops. Faster heat, faster cool.

sensors.name: Probe (Terpometer V1)
sensors.description: Contact probe touches interior surface. Reads SURFACE TRUTH directly.
sensors.calibration_note: No offset applied — your reading IS the surface temp.

sensors.name: IR Thermometer (Dab Rite Pro, Octave, Terpometer Gen 2)
sensors.description: Non-contact IR. Aim per banger geometry — bucket vs slurper-class read differently.
sensors.calibration_note: Apply banger.ir_offset_sign * banger.ir_offset_f. Bucket-class subtracts (display lower than interior). Slurper-class adds (display higher than interior — thinner wall, direct flame contact). Cooldown-trigger workflow: dab on descent through target, NOT at peak torch.

sensors.name: E-Nail PID Setpoint
sensors.description: Coil temp controller. Set & forget. Coil reads 30-80°F higher than surface (varies by brand).
sensors.calibration_note: Add ~50°F midpoint to surface target. MiniNail-on-MiniNail is factory-calibrated to display surface temp directly — set PID to surface target, not the +50°F estimate.

sensors.name: No Thermometer (Visual / Timing)
sensors.description: Glow + count method. Approximate. App estimates based on form factor.
sensors.calibration_note: Use IR-equivalent values as approximate guidance. Visual cue (banger.visual_cue) is the primary signal.

bangers.name: Flat Top
bangers.description: Universal default. Cylindrical bucket, flat rim. ~80% of bangers in market.
bangers.ir_aim_location: Center underside of bucket bottom, 1/2" away

bangers.name: Beveled Edge
bangers.description: Inward-cut bevel for flush bubble cap seal. Better seal lets you target 20-40°F lower than non-beveled flat top.
bangers.ir_aim_location: Center underside of bucket bottom, 1/2" away

bangers.name: Opaque Bottom
bangers.description: Sandblasted/frosted bottom disc. Best IR accuracy of any banger. Use Dab Rite "Opaque Quartz" emissivity preset.
bangers.ir_aim_location: Center of opaque bottom underside, 1/2" away (Dab Rite: switch to Opaque Quartz preset)
bangers.visual_cue: Faint side-wall glow only — opaque hides bottom glow

bangers.name: Thermal (Double Wall)
bangers.description: Air gap between walls insulates inner cup. IR reads cooler than actual oil contact temp because IR sees outer wall — compensate via timing.
bangers.ir_aim_location: Outer base of bucket, 1/2" away (manufacturer-correct aim)
bangers.visual_cue: No glow / faint outer corner glow only

bangers.name: Round Bottom
bangers.description: Hemispherical interior, no corners. Best shape for terp pearls (rolls freely) and cold start (oil pools center).
bangers.ir_aim_location: Lowest curve apex (= bottom center), 1/2" away
bangers.visual_cue: Just before glow on the curve

bangers.name: Core Reactor
bangers.description: Central pillar increases surface area + thermal mass. Cold-start compatible per Honeybee Herb.
bangers.ir_aim_location: Inner bucket floor around pillar, 1/2" away
notable_manufacturers: Honeybee Herb Honey & Milk Core Reactor

bangers.name: Swing-Arm Honey Bucket
bangers.description: Legacy form factor — heat dome out of chamber, swing back in. NOT cold-start compatible.
bangers.ir_aim_location: Outside of dome in heating position, ~1" away

bangers.name: Terp Slurper
bangers.description: Bottom dish + slotted column + bucket. Marble cap. Hot-start required — vortex needs preheat.
bangers.ir_aim_location: Side of cup ~1/2" above the dish (column, NOT dish underside) — Dab Rite 2025 spec

bangers.name: Blender / Vector
bangers.description: Slotted hurricane disc spins pearls automatically. Tighter temp window than slurper.
bangers.ir_aim_location: Side of the tower at mid-height (slurper-class aim — NOT disc underside)

bangers.name: Spinner / Tourbillon
bangers.description: Angled airflow holes drive pearl spin via inhale velocity. Pearl spin is airflow-driven, not temperature-driven.
bangers.ir_aim_location: Side of bucket wall mid-height (avoid drilled holes — radial crack risk)

bangers.name: Control Tower
bangers.description: Highly Educated proprietary slurper with SE Pillar (Surface Enhanced micro-textured quartz). Manufacturer targets: 450°F solventless / 550°F hydrocarbon (interior surface).
bangers.ir_aim_location: Side of the chamber, NOT the dish (Highly Educated FAQ)
bangers.heat_method: simultaneous (heat dish + chamber together, side-to-side AND top-to-bottom)
bangers.visual_cue: Pillar visibly at temp, faint glow in dim room

bangers.name: Quave Charmer
bangers.description: Quave proprietary slurper-blender hybrid. Outer dish with vortex holes, inner cone, three pearls, marble cap.
bangers.ir_aim_location: Side of the cup wall (slurper-class — inferred, no first-party doc)

bangers.name: Quartz Insert (in any banger)
bangers.description: Drop-in cup. Either heat host first then drop insert, or load insert cold and heat host briefly.
bangers.ir_aim_location: Host banger bottom, 1/2" away (read banger temp, not insert directly)

bangers.name: E-Banger / E-Nail
bangers.description: Coil-wrapped quartz with PID. Coil reads 30-80°F hotter than surface (varies widely by brand). MiniNail-on-MiniNail is factory-calibrated to display surface directly.
bangers.ir_aim_location: PID set point — no IR / no torch needed

concentrates.name: Live Rosin
concentrates.description: Fresh-frozen pressed solventless. Glossy amber, sappy.

concentrates.name: Cold Cure Rosin
concentrates.description: Live rosin nucleated to creamy badder. Most popular 2026 rosin format.

concentrates.name: Fresh Press Rosin
concentrates.description: Un-cured rosin. Most volatile-rich, terps not yet homogenized.

concentrates.name: Rosin Jam
concentrates.description: THCa diamonds in terpene-rich rosin sauce. Heterogeneous.

concentrates.name: Rosin Badder
concentrates.description: Whipped/agitated rosin. Hashwriter avg 520°F Terpometer interior.

concentrates.name: Hot Cure Rosin
concentrates.description: Whipped/cured at 90-225°F. Profile shifts to heavier sesquiterpenes.
notes: Caryophyllene dominant — needs more heat than fresh

concentrates.name: Hash Rosin Coin
concentrates.description: Pressed disk from 5-6 star bubble. Premium fresh-frozen input.
notes: Flatten coin into hash flag for even melt

concentrates.name: Persy Hash Rosin
concentrates.description: 710 Labs originated. 6-star 90-micron first-wash bubble pressed to rosin.

concentrates.name: High-Melt / Nug-Run Hash Rosin
concentrates.description: Premium hash rosin from highest-grade nugs. Connoisseur tier 2025-26.
notes: 710 Labs Tier 3, Papa's Select top tier

concentrates.name: Bubble Hash · 6-Star (Full Melt)
concentrates.description: Ice water hash, full-melt grade. Hashwriter avg 477.5°F Terpometer interior.

concentrates.name: Bubble Hash · 3-4 Star (Half Melt)
concentrates.description: Half-melt bubble. Field consensus: don't dab — press to rosin.
notes: Better used as rosin starter material

concentrates.name: Dry Sift (Full Melt)
concentrates.description: Mechanically separated trichomes via 45-160μm screens.

concentrates.name: Temple Ball Hash
concentrates.description: Hand-rolled spherical hash, Nepalese-style. Frenchy Cannoli legacy.
notes: Press Club: 350°F surface (NOT same as rosin 450°F)

concentrates.name: Pressed Hashish (Moroccan/Afghan/Charas)
concentrates.description: Traditional pressed hash. Will char on most bangers.
notes: NOT OPTIMAL for dabbing — expect residue
Better in pipe, joint, or hot knife

concentrates.name: Live Resin
concentrates.description: Fresh-frozen hydrocarbon BHO. ~34% of concentrate sales. Yellow-amber sauce/wax.
notes: Stay <=545°F surface to preserve linalool + humulene

concentrates.name: Cured Resin
concentrates.description: BHO from cured flower. General-purpose hydrocarbon. Lost most volatile monoterps.

concentrates.name: Shatter
concentrates.description: Glassy BHO. Once dominant, now legacy/budget tier.
notes: Most volatile terps already lost in process

concentrates.name: Wax / Budder / Badder
concentrates.description: Whipped BHO. Stable mid-tier across menus.

concentrates.name: Crumble / Honeycomb
concentrates.description: Dry powdery BHO. Lower moisture vaporizes easily.

concentrates.name: Sugar Wax
concentrates.description: Small THCa crystals in terpene matrix. Sugar/sauce texture.
notes: Cold start LOVED for this texture

concentrates.name: Sauce (HTFSE)
concentrates.description: High-terpene full-spectrum extract. ~50% terpenes — viscous syrup with diamonds.

concentrates.name: THCa Diamonds (alone)
concentrates.description: Discrete crystalline gemstones, 95-99% THCa, near-zero terpenes.

concentrates.name: Diamonds & Sauce
concentrates.description: Combined product — crystals in terpene-rich sauce.
notes: Cold start: sauce volatilizes first, then crystals

concentrates.name: THCa Crystalline / Isolate
concentrates.description: Pure powder, >99% THCa. Zero terpenes — no flavor to preserve.
notes: Use sticky binder (live resin) for cold start
Just needs full vaporization of THC

concentrates.name: Liquid Diamonds (cart format)
concentrates.description: Live resin + THCa diamonds. Dominant high-potency cart category 2024-26.
notes: Mostly vaped not dabbed — flag distinction
If dabbing jar form: treat like diamonds & sauce

concentrates.name: CO2 Oil
concentrates.description: Supercritical CO2 extraction. Most volatile terps lost in process.
notes: Fading in dab market — common in carts

concentrates.name: THC Distillate
concentrates.description: ~99% pure, viscous, terpene-stripped. Primarily for carts.
notes: Hemper 400-500°F (smooth) vs Zen Leaf 600-650°F (cloud) — both valid

concentrates.name: CBN Distillate
concentrates.description: CBN-focused, often blended with sleep terpenes.

concentrates.name: CBG Distillate
concentrates.description: CBG-focused. Springer study: degradation begins ~608°F.
notes: CBG boiling: 126°F (very low) — needs gentle heat

concentrates.name: THCV Distillate
concentrates.description: THCV boiling 428°F (highest of common cannabinoids), but matrix needs more.

concentrates.name: Infused Diamonds
concentrates.description: Strain-specific or terpene-infused diamonds.

concentrates.name: THCP Concentrates
concentrates.description: Hemp-derived. Very small % since extremely potent (~33x CB1 binding).
concentrates.warning: Regulatory uncertainty — Nov 2026 federal hemp ban
notes: REGULATORY FLAG: H.R. 5371 (Nov 2026) federal hemp redefinition

concentrates.name: Hash Holes / Donut Joints
concentrates.description: Pre-roll with central rosin/bubble hash worm. NOT A DAB.
concentrates.blocked: This is a pre-roll format. Light it and smoke it — don't put it on a banger.

concentrates.name: Kief / Static
concentrates.description: Loose unrefined trichome powder. Dust, low-melt.
concentrates.blocked: Kief is too dusty for direct dabs and will combust unevenly. Press it to rosin first, or use as bowl topper.
notes: Best as bowl topper, joint infusion, or pressed to rosin/hash

concentrates.name: RSO / FECO
concentrates.description: Rick Simpson Oil / Full Extract Cannabis Oil. Oral/topical format.
concentrates.blocked: RSO is meant for oral or topical use. Dabbing is harsh due to chlorophyll, waxes, and residual solvents.
notes: NOT FOR DABBING — sublingual, capsules, food

concentrates.name: Bubble Hash · 1-2 Star
concentrates.description: Cooking-grade ice water hash. Not dabbable.
concentrates.blocked: 1-2 star bubble has too much plant matter. Use it for edibles or press multiple grades together to rosin.
notes: Edibles only — too much plant matter
